notes.note: #373: replaced the head-keyed, data_version-invalidated usage polling cache sentence with the durable per-session fold (orchestration_usage_projection_cache), its global_sequence watermark, the delete/update triggers, and the conditions that refold every session. Checked against SessionTranscriptReads.listSessionUsage, EventStore.advanceUsageProjection/writeUsageProjections and 030-usage-projection-cache.ts; the shared usage fold still owns token, cost, activity, attribution and relay-mirror rules.

#373: the Profile usage paragraph now says a rebuild rereads only engine sessions whose events changed, that deleted or rewritten events drop a session's kept fold so totals equal a full refold, names the two station.usage_projection metrics, and that Rebuild usage discards the kept folds. Checked against usage-aggregator.ts (fullRescan rebuild option, sliced engine fold), the analytics rescan route, and usage-projection-incremental.test.ts.

GET /api/analytics/usage claims (once-a-minute active rebuild, shared in-flight rebuild, snapshot fields) are unchanged.
